Comment: Agentic ML+Robotics deployment: plan a strategy, provision the green stack, then run a gated rollout loop. Each step observes fleet health and a decision tree returns promote/hold/rollback. Health guardrail breaches route to an atomic rollback; a clean run promotes the candidate.

PlanStrategy.Comment: Agent chooses canary vs blue/green and the traffic steps.

ProvisionGreen.Comment: Apply Service + baseline (blue) manifests; prepare the green stack.

RolloutStep.Comment: Shift traffic for this step, observe health, and evaluate the decision tree.

EvaluateGate.Comment: Route on the decision-tree verdict for the current step.

Rollback.Comment: Revert all traffic to the baseline and have the agent explain why.

RolledBack.Cause: A fleet health signal breached its guardrail; candidate was rolled back.

Promote.Comment: Finalize: candidate becomes the new baseline.
